description: Agent Control: submit a caching design for agent context or instructions: each cached element with what it holds (policy, prices, permissions, instructions, tool schemas and others), its TTL and the events that clear it, what changes underneath with how soon each change must take effect, and the decisions made from cached context. The signed report names every cached element that can outlive a change to its source, every decision that can be made from stale context, and the invalidation rule that closes each gap. Agent memory stores are wever_memory-design-check. Verdict outlives_changes, freshness_unverified or invalidated_on_change. POST /api/cache-staleness-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

apply_within.description: How soon it must take effect, such as 5 minutes.

change.description: What changes underneath, such as the refund policy.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
